result.summary: Several visual and layout issues are present: truncated restaurant names, a loading spinner overlaying a popular item card, partially cut-off category chips and restaurant cards, and incomplete bottom content.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off in the Fastest near you section.
issues.suggestion: Allow text wrapping, reduce font size, or use ellipsis with full name on a second line or tooltip so the full name is readable.

issues.description: A large circular loading spinner is centered over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image, obscuring the food photo and looking broken or stuck.
issues.suggestion: Show a proper skeleton/placeholder while loading, or hide the spinner once the image has loaded; ensure the spinner does not permanently cover content.

issues.description: Category filter chips row is cut off on the right (partial chip visible after Healthy), suggesting horizontal overflow without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll is obvious, add fade/peek for more chips, or wrap/adjust spacing so chips are fully visible.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in Fastest near you is partially clipped at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width, padding, or carousel peek so cards don’t appear cut off unintentionally.

issues.description: Bottom restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is heavily cropped by the bottom navigation, so most of the card and any title/details below are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/scroll inset so full cards can be scrolled into view above the tab bar.

issues.description: Promotional banner and list sections compete for space while a spinner covers a key popular item, making the feed feel incomplete or broken.
issues.suggestion: Prioritize finished loaded states for above-the-fold popular items and avoid indefinite overlay spinners on primary cards.
